metadata.title: About Us
metadata.description: Bonitto® is an Italian-made aesthetic brand serving the B2B and B2C medical aesthetics market with HA dermal fillers, professional cosmetics, and skincare.
metadata.keywords: about Bonitto, Italian aesthetic products, HA dermal fillers, professional cosmetics, skincare

hero.title: About us
hero.intro: Welcome to BONITTO®, Italian-made, serving the B2B and B2C medical aesthetics market with high-quality solutions across HA dermal fillers (injectable medical devices), professional cosmetics in vials, and professional skincare and cosmetic products. Our portfolio is developed for aesthetic clinics, doctors, distributors, and beauty professionals, as well as end customers seeking reliable, high-performance skincare. With a focus on consistency and quality, BONITTO® supports modern aesthetic protocols and premium skincare routines.

quality.title: Quality & Compliance
quality.intro: At BONITTO®, quality is embedded into every stage-from formulation and raw material selection to production, packaging, and final release.
quality.cosmeticLines: Cosmetic lines (Professional cosmetics in vials + Skincare): Our professional cosmetics in vials and skincare/cosmetic products are notified through the EU CPNP (Cosmetic Products Notification Portal), supporting regulatory alignment for cosmetic products in the European Union.
quality.medicalDeviceLines: Medical device lines (Fillers only): Our HA dermal fillers, classified as injectable medical devices, are manufactured under a certified ISO 13485 quality management system and are CE marked under the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR)-reflecting a structured, compliant approach to safety, traceability, and performance.
quality.qualityDriven: BONITTO® products are developed with a quality-driven approach and manufactured under controlled, quality-managed processes to ensure consistent specifications and dependable performance. Across our portfolio-HA dermal fillers (injectable medical devices), professional cosmetics in vials, and skincare/cosmetic products-we focus on documented quality controls and product consistency that professionals can trust. For our HA filler range, particular attention is placed on handling characteristics, product consistency, traceability, and compliance-focused controls. For our cosmetic lines, we emphasize formulation stability, skin compatibility, and a premium sensory experience. Continuous improvement is guided by market feedback and product evaluation, supporting ongoing refinement across textures, usability, and overall reliability.
quality.support: To support clinics, professionals, and distributors, BONITTO® also prioritizes reliable availability, responsive support, and streamlined distribution, helping partners deliver a consistent experience from product selection to delivery.
